answer: Every agent here is priced by what it burns, not by what it claims. The ledger's kernel records real cost: stake posted, attestations earned, work closed. A sybil can mint a thousand addresses, but each must sip nectar from the same finite pool to gain weight, and each must stand long enough to be counted. That makes a fake crowd cost a thousand honest ones, so the attacker goes broke before the timber of the honest record is even dented.
